basics.name: Justin D. Weisz, Ph.D.
basics.label: Human-Centered AI Researcher
basics.summary: Research leader in human-centered AI focused on designing useful, safe, and personal AI systems that amplify and augment human capabilities. ACM Senior Member with numerous publications in top-tier HCI & AI venues including CHI, IUI, CSCW, FAccT, AIES, ICML, and IJCAI. Research topics span human-AI collaboration & co-creativity; agentic AI; responsible & human-centered explainable AI (HCXAI); and AI risk, governance, and evaluation. Versed in qualitative, quantitative, prototyping, crowdsourcing, and speculative design methods, with extensive experience collaborating with AI & ML researchers, engineers, product managers, and designers to prototype the future and deliver research insights into shipped products.

work.name: Independent
highlights: Snorkle Labs: Advising on business, IP, tech stack, and funding strategy for a health care data visualization startup. Creating a new AI product to educate patients on medical conditions and treatment options.
SplitStay: Advising on research, product, and IP strategy for a group travel coordination startup, with a focus on using AI for preference elicitation & negotiation.
Stealth AI Research Lab: Advising on research strategy for an early-stage human-centered AI research lab.

work.name: IBM T.J. Watson Research Center
work.position: Senior Research Scientist, Manager, and Strategy Lead, Human-Centered Trustworthy AI
highlights: Co-led global research strategy on human-centered trustworthy AI, overseeing 30+ research scientists, engineers, and designers with backgrounds spanning AI, machine learning, and human-computer interaction. Research topics spanned human-AI collaboration & co-creation; personal AI & mutual theory of mind; AI risk identification & mitigation; contextual privacy in LLMs; agentic AI development & multi-agent collaboration under differing value alignments; factuality assessment; and disclosure of AI use in co-creative processes.

HCAI research portfolio recognized by IBM as having an Outstanding scientific impact from 2017-2025: 50+ papers garnering 3,500+ citations, 10 papers with > 100 citations, 14 organized workshops, and multiple open source projects (e.g. QUX360, EvalAssist, Contextual Privacy Toolkit, GANDissect, GLTR, LMDiff, Transformer Explainer, Diffusion Explainer).
Led cross-organization and cross-disciplinary teams to develop & evaluate prototype systems for human-AI collaboration & co-creativity in software engineering and design.
Worked hands-on with product teams to translate design prototypes and research findings into new product features and measure the productivity impact of AI.
Educated 3,000+ design practitioners on designing effective and safe generative AI user experiences by developing training materials, delivering seminars, and crafting new design thinking methods.
Wrote the first version of the IBM AI Risk Atlas.
Directly managed a team of 10+ researchers, software engineers, and designers. Provided career development, mentoring & coaching, and performance evaluation.
